bias: 'The bulls have their opening. Now comes the hard part.' Monday delivered the first meaningful evidence that the market is rejecting lower value rather than accepting it: NQ defended 27313-27339 (July RTH low) at the open and ripped through Friday's high, filled Thursday's B-singles and advanced deep into the A-singles to 28080-28100; ES defended 7454-7458 premarket and at the OR5 low, reclaimed the August low 7539-7543, held it from above and tested the September low 7569-7575 (an Iran headline extended it to 7600.5), closing right at that reference and above the October low 7558.25. Monday's buying was distinctly different from last Wednesday's — broad, off a critical HTF location — so he's not fighting the developing bullish auction without compelling evidence sellers have regained control. At minimum that means Monday's RTH low taken out; convincingly, renewed acceptance back within Friday's range. 'A rejection from an overhead reference alone is insufficient.' Not out of the woods: both remain inside Thursday's enormous range.
wildcard: CPI premarket — a binary event, so predefined setups are limited and the auction has to support them. A sell-side response may be more informative than a bullish one (does Monday's structure get defended?); a bullish response could carry both through several references — then the question is whether buyers hold them from above. NQ: Thursday's range is the mother bar (yellow box); Monday's high, Thursday's open and Thursday's high are collectively the upper boundary; the 200-day SMA sits just above Monday's high; regaining the prior four-day balance (white box) above Thursday's high is the first major accomplishment. ES: 7619-7624 (inside Thursday's A-singles) and 7645-7650 (June high 7648.75, white box top) are the two most important decisions above. Daily: ES 7662, 7631-7634, 7562-7563 (LBAF monitor), 7526-7531, 7514-7518, 7454-7458, 7412-7415; NQ 27798-27815 (LBAF monitor), 27689 (LBAF monitor), 27110-27123, 27057.

brief.happened: Beautiful two-way overnight (7385.5-7476.5); the premarket battle was a potential LAAF of 7469-7473, but buyers defended 7454-7458 premarket and at the OR5 low 7455.75, then a nearly uninterrupted rally: reclaimed 7539-7543 (B-period singles ~7526-7536), held it from above, struggled initially at 7569-7575, Iran headline → 7600.5 at 15:15, closed 7572.25 — back above the October low 7558.25 and essentially at the September low 7575. Still well inside Thursday's range; Thursday's A-singles (7603+) not yet reached.
brief.pivot: 7562-7563 roughly preserves Monday's upper distribution: hold/LBAF → back toward Monday's high if 7569-7575 is firmly reclaimed; sustained below → 7539-7543 and 7526-7531 (the B-singles), where a responsive bid is another chance for buyers — then the retests of 62-63 and 69-75 from below decide. Acceptance below 7514-7518 (top of Monday's A-singles) materially raises the odds of a rotation to Monday's RTH low 7455.75.
brief.higher: 7619-7624 (within Thursday's A-singles) and 7645-7650 (June high / white box top) are the two most important decision areas; the region ~7558 (broadly 7441) to 7648.75 is the overlap of the two major monthly ranges. How ES responds there, and whether buyers establish acceptance above, tells us about the durability of Monday's recovery. Above: 7662, 7670-7680, 7708-7713.
brief.lower: Pullbacks into Monday's structure are opportunities for buyers to reassert themselves unless sellers get meaningful traction below Monday's RTH low 7455.75 — and the truly bearish development is a failure to defend that low followed by renewed acceptance within Friday's range (7392-7469) and last week's lower distribution.

brief.happened: Two-way overnight (26751.25-27378), defended 27313-27339 at the open (RTH low 27316.25 = July RTH low), ripped through Friday's high, filled Thursday's B-singles (27425-27458) and advanced well into the A-singles — Monday's own A-singles sit below 27689, a small set of singles at 27798-27815 — to 28129.25 at 15:25, into 28080-28100 and just below the first major HTF decision at 28200-28233; closed 28004.75.
brief.pivot: Monday's high / Thursday's open / Thursday's high = the upper boundary of the developing range until proven otherwise; the 200-day SMA sits just above Monday's high. 27798-27815 preserves Monday's primary distribution (hold/LBAF = the conservative long); 27689 next (A-singles below; sustained below raises the risk of a liquidation break toward Monday's open/low, but watch for a quick LBAF that reclaims 798-815). brief.higher: A rejection/LAAF of Monday's high — whether or not Thursday's high is taken first — can produce weakness, but sellers must overcome Monday's structure to regain control. Reclaiming and accepting above 28200-28233 (June low) is the first major HTF reclaim; above Thursday's high = back inside the prior four-day balance and out of the mother bar. The September-low reclaim (28847-28869 / 29038-29069) is not yet achieved but increasingly in play.
brief.lower: Below 27689 → 27425-27458 (Friday's high) → 27313-27339 (July RTH low ≈ Monday's RTH low). Even a substantially deeper pullback doesn't invalidate the bull case as long as price rejects re-entry into last week's lower distribution below Monday's low; sustained acceptance below Monday's low = Monday failed to establish durable higher value → rotation through Friday's range.
